# What does a do for 1.5 weeks between jobs? 🤔 | Ana Corio · LinkedIn · 2020-07-08

**Ana Corio**: Director of Demand Generation at Harmonic Security for 1 year 11 months with 15 years 8 months of total professional experience. Previous roles include Director of Demand Generation at Material Security, Growth Marketing Strategist at CrowdStrike, and Senior Content Marketing & Digital Strategy Manager at Digital Shadows (Acquired by Reliaquest). Based in San Francisco, California, United States [US].

---

What does a #marketingnerd do for 1.5 weeks between jobs? 🤔

1. Hit the beach for a mind break. 🏖
2. About 30 minutes into beach time, reflect on previous role, evaluate goals, and realize you absolutely suck at relaxing.
3. Binge marketing content in specific areas of interest. (For me - #growthmarketing #contentmarketing #digitalmarketing)
4. Make a gameplan: List out ideas, set goals, and clean-up marketing newsletter & podcast subscription list.
5. Realize you should’ve reapplied that sunscreen an hour ago and your beverage is now warm. 🤦🏻♀️

Any other #marketing nerds out there? 🤓
#lovewhatyoudoReally fantastic#kindredspirits 😂Solid itinerary, that.

Previous roles include Director of Demand Generation at Material Security, Growth Marketing Strategist at CrowdStrike, and Senior Content Marketing & Digital Strategy Manager at Digital Shadows (Acquired by Reliaquest). Based in San Francisco, California, United States [US].

---

One of my favorite parts of this job is watching someone on the team turn "we should really do this" into an actual thing. 📰

There is SO much AI security content out there right now, and most of it is a vendor pitch in disguise. Security teams don't need more noise, they need to know what's actually changing and what to prioritize.

So... we built "The Frequency". Monthly (to start), 5 min read, zero fluff:

✅ What's Trending – a practical, actionable guide on AI governance
✅ Industry Map – what's shifting and what it means for you
✅ On the Record – a practitioner spotlight on real AI builds
✅ The B-Side – what the team's listening to (our founders [Bryan](https://linkedin.com/in/bwoolgaroneil) and [Alastair](https://linkedin.com/in/alastair-paterson-2586445) did start as a band, after all 🎸)
